items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: I’m playing all types of crazy shit you know, like Niels Orsted Pederson

ctx.x: What happens when you travel somewhere and you can’t take your own bass?

Well I just deal with — I deal with whatever. I mean I have, I’ll say this, now that happens. And if it’s a bass that’s set up for only an amp, like I’ll try to use it acoustically. But some basses you get and the action is this high, and you literally — so there’s been probably five to ten times where yeah, I’ll go on a gig and I’ve had to play that bas — and you know it is so fucking easy I sound like Miroslav Vitous, I’m playing all types of crazy shit you know, like Niels Orsted Pederson, I’m all — because it…
I like your mix of descriptive terms ‘cause you’ve said “pretty” a few times, but you don’t necessarily like your bass to be [scats] pretty. You want it to have some natural oomph.
